# WJ32 · Lịch hẹn của bot · job lỗi hoặc bị chặn

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · state · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/schedules`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
State of [WJ30](WJ30.md) · Lịch hẹn của bot: job lỗi hoặc bị chặn. Page: Schedules of the bot: automatic messages or one agent turn on a timetable (once, every N minutes, cron). View, edit, try now, see the run history.

## Agent and care context
- On a `patient_channel` account a schedule can only send a message made from a doctor-approved template (kind "Nhắn tin"); an agent job only drafts text for a reviewer and never sends by itself (WJ34). Proactive sending stays inside the send window and the daily cap of the channel.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.schedules`.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: "Lịch tự động" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `admin.schedules`.

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- "Thêm lịch hẹn"; account filter
- Switch on or off; "Chạy thử ngay"; "Lịch sử"; "Sửa"; "Xóa"

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).
